description: This file defines the final class UriResolver in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, providing static methods for resolving and relativizing URI references according to RFC 3986, including handling dot segments and relative paths.

classes.name: UriResolver
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to resolve and relativize URI references according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: removeDotSegments
methods.description: Removes dot segments from a URI path, normalizing it according to RFC 3986 section 5.2.4.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative URI against a base URI to produce an absolute URI.

methods.name: relativize
methods.description: Returns a relative reference from a base URI to a target URI.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Helper method to compute the relative path between two URIs.
